model.title: To authorize the Secretary of the Army to convey to the State of North Carolina a certain parcel of real property located at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, on which the State shall construct a veterans' State home, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Armed Services Committee · Rep. Richard Hudson (R-NC)

summary.text: The bill would authorize the Department of the Army to transfer a 20-acre parcel of land at Fort Bragg to North Carolina at no cost. The state would use the property to build a veterans' home to care for disabled veterans and provide nursing care, with North Carolina covering all costs associated with the transfer. The land would revert to federal ownership if it stops being used for the veterans' home.
